name: Carbamazepine
effects: Sodium channel blocker — reduces neuronal firing
Strong CYP450 inducer — major drug interactions
Rare but life-threatening Stevens-Johnson syndrome (especially HLA-B*1502 carriers)
Aplastic anemia and agranulocytosis risk — blood monitoring required

halfLifeEvidence.quote: Elimination half-life 36 hours (single dose), 16–24 hours (repeated dosing)
halfLifeEvidence.identity: the source is about this substance
halfLifeEvidence.note: The 36-hour figure is a single dose; anyone taking carbamazepine is on repeated dosing, which is the range stored.
